Negeri Sembilan Assembly Dissolved 

Negeri Sembilan Menteri Besar Aminuddin Harun has announced the official dissolution of the state legislative assembly as of June 5, 2026. 

Triggering a snap election more than two years ahead of schedule, the development follows a political crisis where 14 UMNO assemblymen withdrew their support over a royal dispute. 

Constitutional frameworks mandate that fresh state polls must be executed within a strict 60-day window.
